title: SSTI: user input rendered as template code, escalated to RCE per engine
index_line: T-0004 · TEMPLATE_EVAL · {{7*7}} polyglot first, engine chain second · corroborated
invariant_violated: The app treats user input as template data; the engine evaluates it as template code.

mechanism.does: user-controlled string reaches a render call
engine parses the string as a template
engine evaluates the expression — polyglot probe {{7*7}}/${7*7}/<%= 7*7 %> confirms
engine sandbox/filter defeated via attr notation, hex escapes, {%print%} forms
engine-specific escape chain reaches os/Runtime exec

source.http.request.value: any input reflected into a render call (name, template field, filename in a rendered page)

guard.sandbox.value: engine sandbox or output filter if present

gadget.engine-escape.value: Jinja2 config.__class__ chain · Twig 1.x registerUndefinedFilterCallback / Twig 3 filter('system') · Freemarker ?new Execute · Velocity $class.forName reflection

preconditions.expr: template engine in the dependency tree
request input reaches the render call
varies — often low; render surfaces are frequently public

success: computed output (49) reflected in the response
OOB callback or >=5s delay via popen('sleep 5') in the escape chain
engine-specific fingerprint probe answered ({{config}} vs {{dump()}} vs ${.version})
failure_like: autoescape renders the probe literally ({{7*7}} visible as text)

hazards: sandboxed engines need the attribute-chain escape — fingerprint the engine AND its sandbox version
Java engines need the gadget classes reachable from template context

rust — no mainstream server template eval
